title: Translation bundle
description: The `translations` object of GET /api/i18n/translations/{locale}, shared with the web app and accepted by aun-i18n (I18n::add_builtin_bundle). Nested objects become dotted keys. Plural variants use i18next suffixes (`key_zero`, `key_one`, `key_two`, `key_few`, `key_many`, `key_other`, selected by the `count` argument with CLDR rules) or ICU `{count, plural, ...}` inside a message. Placeholders: `{{name}}` or `{name}`.
